name: Zettai Junshu ★ New Kozukuri World
original_name: ぜったい遵守★にゅ～こづくりわーるど
source:
The dwindling number of children due to declining birth rates was a problem, but people continued on with their lives with only a slight concern. However, the world gradually began to notice an unusual phenomenon: no boys were being born. At first, people were optimistic that it was just a coincidence, but the birth rate for boys rapidly declined year by year. Before long, it was at 1 boy per 8585 births, and it was not an unusual sight to find only one male within each city. The day of human extinction draws closer….

Then, a boy genius Touma was born. With unparalleled intelligence, he was labelled as a child prodigy who would ultimately save the human race. As the years pass, he skipped many grades and graduated from university, running for and becoming the youngest member of the Diet. Standing in the packed assembly hall, he proclaimed that in order to save the nation and the human race, there must be change: the introduction of the free sex licence!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
translation:
出生率下降导致儿童数量减少，本来是个问题，但人们仍带着些许担忧继续生活。然而，世界逐渐注意到一种异常现象：没有男孩出生。起初，人们乐观地认为这只是巧合，但男孩出生率逐年快速下降。不久后，每8585次出生中才有1名男孩，在每座城市里只能找到一名男性也不再罕见。人类灭亡的日子越来越近……

就在这时，天才男孩冬真出生了。他拥有无与伦比的智慧，被称为最终将拯救人类的神童。随着年岁增长，他跳级无数，大学毕业后参选并成为国会最年轻的议员。他站在座无虚席的议事厅里，宣称为了拯救国家与人类，必须做出改变：引入自由性爱许可证！
